description: This file defines the ConnectionLogScope class, which implements IReadOnlyList for key-value pairs related to a Connection object, providing scoped logging information for network connections, including connection IDs and endpoints.

classes.name: ConnectionLogScope
classes.description: An internal class providing a read-only list of key-value pairs representing connection details for logging purposes.

methods.name: ConnectionLogScope
methods.description: Constructor initializing the scope with a Connection object.

methods.name: this[int index]
methods.description: Indexer returning key-value pairs of connection info based on index.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Property returning number of items in the list (fixed at 3).

methods.name: GetEnumerator
methods.description: Returns an enumerator for iterating over key-value pairs.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Generates a string representation of the connection, caching the result.
